categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the standard discharge pathway for patients after successful admission and treatment, evaluated against post-discharge ER return indicators, contributing positively to avoiding post-discharge deterioration.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release A (id=17) as observed in multiple variants such as V0008, V0070, and V0069 representing normal discharge outcomes.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge pathway following inpatient care, tracked via post-discharge ER return measures and supporting the avoidance of post-discharge deterioration.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release B (id=18) as seen in rare variants like V0068 and V0145.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Represents a specific discharge route for long-stay or complex admitted cases, measured against post-discharge return rates.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release C (id=19) as observed in prolonged complex variants such as V0710.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Represents a specialized discharge pathway for patients requiring extended recovery monitoring prior to leaving the hospital.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release D (id=20) corresponding to outcomes found in complex long-duration trace samples like V0273.

categories.name: Release E
categories.description: Represents alternative discharge routing for specific treated patient subsets.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release E (id=21) based on the goal model decomposition axis without subdivision since no distinct sub-patterns emerged.
